Solara — (9.7) SYZYGY

STRATEGIC PLANNING

"Strategic planning — everyone's talking"

[Verse 1]

Cassie called the meeting

Seven minutes later

Everyone was still arriving

Drift arrived from twenty minutes ago

Rumble sat down — two chairs broke

Pebble was already there

Nobody knew

“We need a formation”

Everyone agreed

And then immediately disagreed

About what that meant

[Pre-Chorus]

Twenty-seven ideas

Twelve sub-ideas

One question from Vael

That nobody could answer

[Chorus]

Strategic planning — everyone’s talking

Strategic planning — nobody agrees

But we have a plan

We have to have a plan

We march to 289

We need to have a plan

[THE IDEAS]

Castor: “Standard wedge. Me at the front. Herc on left.”

Herc: “I want to be at the front”

Castor: “You will break the formation”

Herc: “Yes. That is my strategy”

Chaos: “I see a clear opening on the right flank”

Everyone looked right

There was a wall

“…a future opening”

Vael: “Should the front be the front? What if the front is actually the back?”

Silence

“Is that a bad question?”

More silence

“Was the silence a yes or a no?”

Fable told everyone the plan was already working

Echo repeated it with Glimmer’s voice

Glimmer released a burst by accident

Everyone ducked

PEBBLE had a suggestion

The table heard it

Nobody else did

[Soup interlude]

Solvren brought the soup

Thresh: “Current excellence percentage”

Solvren: “Forty-three”

“That is lower than yesterday”

“The stakes are higher”

“That should improve the soup”

“It has affected the soup differently”

Cygnus, still wearing the boots:

“The soup is not the problem”

“What is the problem,” said Castor

“THE BOOTS”

“Cygnus—”

“FORTY-THREE PERCENT AND THE BOOTS”

[The Fold 7 incident]

Lorn raised a hand

“The chicken in Fold 7—”

“LORN”

“—has resolved the formation issue”

“What”

“They use a crescent shape in Fold 7”

“How do you know”

“I have been watching”

“DURING THIS MEETING”

“The meeting is also happening in Fold 7”

“ARE THEY HAVING THE SOUP PROBLEM”

“Their soup is sixty-eight percent”

Thresh wrote this down

[The vote]

Cassie called a vote

Four formations on the table:

Castor’s wedge

Herc’s “break everything”

Lorn’s crescent from Fold 7

Persy’s formation, which he had not explained

and was called “obvious”

“All in favor of the wedge?”

Majority

“All in favor of—”

Rumble stamped to vote

The table moved

Everyone’s notes were on the floor

Mira: “I warned you this would happen”

“When”

“Just now”

“That was after it happened”

“…yes”

[Bridge — the plan]

Twenty minutes later

The plan was: crescent entry

Castor at the point

Herc at the left flank — officially allowed to break things

The Ones: contained in the middle

Chaos on right, Vael questioning every decision before it becomes wrong

Pebble: advance terrain work

Drift: time disruption on approach

Glimmer: signal only, aim to be determined

Fable: morale — she will make them believe they’re winning

Mira: early warning, factoring the delay

Cygnus would be wherever the boots allowed

[Final Chorus]

Strategic planning — done

Forty-three percent soup — consumed

The boots — still a problem

The chicken — noted

The plan — somehow real

We march to 289

We have a plan — we march

[Outro]

Cassie looked at the plan

The plan looked reasonable — from a distance

Rumble: “Is this good”

“It is what we have”

“Is what we have good”

Castor: “It is what we have”

Cygnus danced once — in the boots

Small

The kind that means: fine

The meeting was over

Level 280 in three weeks
